paragraphs: The 530i was part of the seventh-generation 5 Series (G30/G31) from 2017 to 2023. It uses the B48 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbocharged petrol engine that sits at the heart of BMW's modern modular engine family, sharing its architecture with the six-cylinder B58. The B48 is generally well-regarded for its combination of efficiency and responsiveness, and it's found across a wide range of BMW models of this era, from the 3 Series to the X3.
about.boldParagraph: The 530i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the 530i uses a single engine code across its production run, compatibility is simpler than some multi-engine variants — the B48 is consistent across the G30/G31 generation. However, there can still be differences in ECU calibration, ancillary fitment, and emissions specification depending on the exact model year. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact production date via registration or VIN
Your specific B48 variant (there are power output variations across the BMW range)
Any ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic 530i quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
